identitySignals: OUSD's own Legistar record (File 19-1362) names 'L. Luster & Associates, Inc.' of Oakland, CA for outreach and construction management support on a Facilities Planning & Management project, matching the agenda text and the facilities contract type
GovCB (federal vendor data) lists 'L LUSTER & ASSOCIATES INC' in Oakland, CA as a woman-owned, minority-owned small business doing management consulting and professional services
research.notes: The firm's own website (llusterassociates.com) could not be fetched (TLS certificate error), and no registry page (CA SOS, SAM.gov) could be read, so website, phone, email, address and registry IDs are left null. Third-party aggregators list conflicting addresses and phones (3390 Victor Ave, Oakland 94602; 212 9th St Suite 309, Oakland). Founder Dr. Laura Luster now appears at a different firm, Luster National (Mill Valley), whose contact details must NOT be used for this vendor; the relationship between the two firms was not established.

profile.summary: A small, woman-owned and minority-owned consulting firm based in Oakland, California. It provides management consulting and professional services, including outreach and construction management support on public facilities projects.
